title: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton to have surgery on dislocated ankle, will be out 3-4 months

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton to have surgery on dislocated ankle, will be out 3-4 months
sources.description: Chiefs wide receiver Tyquan Thornton went for more tests on his injured ankle on Monday and they confirmed that he will need to have surgery to repair a dislocation.
